About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.
We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company .
Are you ready to take your partner marketing skills to the next level? Join our dynamic Checkr’s Marketing team to shape our partner marketing strategy and lead execution. Your role will drive revenue growth via joint marketing efforts with existing and new partners in our ecosystem.
This role will require working closely with partner, marketing, and sales teams to implement campaign plans with strategic partners. The ideal candidate has solid experience in partner marketing programs and an intuitive understanding of demand generation and product marketing fundamentals.
If you’re a strategic thinker, a hands-on executor, and a collaborator at heart, we want to hear from you. Join us and be part of an exciting journey to build a data platform that powers safe and fair decisions.

Strategy : Create strategies to fuel growth across the partner ecosystem, inform partner prioritization and develop joint marketing plans to drive product sign-ups and revenue
Execution : Own campaign execution together with partners (i.e. email, webinars, events, in-product activations, paid social, etc.) and identify the budget and resources required
Messaging : Craft compelling copy used in co-marketing programs in collaboration with partners, product marketing and content team
Innovation : Identify and pilot new initiatives with partners using marketing development funds to maximize pipeline and revenue
Stakeholders : Develop and maintain strong relationships with partners and collaborate closely with internal teams to integrate partners into the Go-To-Market strategy and campaigns
Analytics : Measure performance and conduct analysis to assess and communicate the performance of co-marketing activities, identifying areas for improvement

6+ years of experience in partner marketing in the B2B SaaS space, preferably focused on SMB and Mid-Market segments
Proven track record of creating and executing successful partner marketing programs and building win-win relationships with partners
Strong organizational and strategic thinking skills, the ability to work independently, and the capacity to effectively manage multiple projects
Courage to take the initiative, pilot and evaluate new program types
Deep understanding of the customer journey through and with a partners
Experience in leveraging AI to optimize partner programs and strategy
Cross-functional leadership and experience driving alignment across different teams
Hands-on experience with GTM & digital marketing tools, such as Salesforce, Marketo, Google Analytics, Looker
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

We’re looking for a Snr. Product Marketing Manager who’s equal parts strategist, storyteller, and builder. If you’re energized by the idea of shaping how innovative construction tech solutions go to market and you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this might be your next opportunity.
In this role, you will collaborate with marketing, product management, and enablement teams to bring new solutions to market and connect with customers in meaningful ways. Product marketing experience in construction tech is preferred.

Partner with product management to shape needs, positioning and messaging that resonates with real-world users
Identify market trends, collect and synthesize competitive intelligence, and stay close to the customer to uncover opportunities
Define buyer personas, buyer needs, and map the journey from awareness to adoption
Translate technical features into clear, compelling value for our buyers and customers

Own the go-to-market marketing strategy and process for new products and major updates
Support the cross-functional launch planning with sales enablement, product management, and marketing
Create value prop messaging, sales tools, launch content, and campaigns that drive adoption and revenue
Track performance and iterate and optimize

Build feedback loops with customers to inform product and messaging decisions
Collaborate with sales and customer success to surface insights from the field
Contribute to thought leadership and industry conversations-especially in construction tech-through blogs, short-form video, webinars, live- presentations, customer conversations.
Ensure our messaging reflects the real-world challenges and wins of our users

Drive measurable revenue growth through product adoption and usage
Shape how we talk about our products, internally and externally
Bring the voice of the customer into everything we do
Make our team (and our users) smarter with every project you touch

Impact from Day One : You’ll own critical go-to-market initiatives and see your work influence revenue and product strategy.
Growth & Mentorship: Direct exposure to senior leadership, structured learning opportunities, and a clear path for advancement.
Culture of Curiosity: Our team value collaboration, experimentation, and bold thinking. We celebrate wins, learn from failures, and share a passion for transforming how the construction industry works.
A Chance to Shape an Industry: Construction tech is evolving fast. You’ll help define how the market understands and embraces innovation.

Bachelor’s Degree
4+ years in product marketing, product management, or marketing in B2B SaaS
Experience in construction technology, such as estimation, data, project management construction software preferred
Experience leading product launches and working closely with Product teams
Strong writing and storytelling skills, you know how to make complex ideas simple

About Outreach

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions.

From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team.

World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.

At Outreach, product marketing doesn't just support the business, it shapes how thousands of revenue teams experience the platform every day. You'll join a tight-knit team that works at the center of Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience, tackling problems with a direct line to customer outcomes and company growth.
We're curious, collaborative, and a little obsessed with making things better. We push each other to do our best work, enjoy doing it and we genuinely have each other's backs.

At Outreach, what we build changes how thousands of sales teams sell every day. We're looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to support our product launches and AI innovations with messaging, positioning and go-to-market planning that is compelling to our customers and prospects.

You'll be the expert on your product, building value propositions that connect with buyers and giving our Marketing, Sales, Partner, and Customer teams what they need to win. If you love turning powerful technology into clear, simple stories that drive pipeline and revenue, you'll feel right at home here.

Your Daily Adventures Will Include
Conducting market and customer research to stay in touch with buyer needs, and create and maintain clear, differentiated messaging that resonates with our target audience
Be the customer and product subject matter expert on pains and needs
Owning the core bill of materials including messaging framework, FAQ, and demos to enable our sales teams
Developing and executing the go-to-market plan for new product/feature releases collaborating across Engineering/Product, Marketing, Finance, Sales & Customer Success teams
Cross-functional collaboration across GTM teams regarding messaging and high-value solution assets
Demonstrating a strong ability to lead cross-functional teams to drive business and product results that measurably deliver company impact and pipeline
Bringing exceptional ability to drive key business objectives with data-driven, fact-based insights that lead to well-informed strategic plans, quick decision making, and impactful outcomes
Our Vision of You
5-7+ years of experience working as a product marketer in the technology industry
Exceptional communication, writing and presentation skills
Experience defining and executing go-to-market strategies across marketing, sales, partner and customer teams
History creating messaging frameworks and positioning for individual and platform solutions that resonate with buyers
Ability to deliver clear and compelling customer-facing messaging and materials
Experience using AI tools to accelerate content creation, streamline workflows, and outputs
Expertise in B2B SaaS with the ability to rapidly gain an in-depth knowledge of the Outreach, the Revenue Orchestration category, competitors and their AI advancements
Proven ability to drive key business objectives with quick decision making for impactful outcomes
Bachelor's degree required

s.h: The Mindset to Succeed in the Role
s.t:
Enthusiastic with strong attention to detail, creative, open-minded, persistent, and highly collaborative
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment and consistently deliver key milestones
A self-starter who takes ownership of projects and follows through

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Customer Marketing Manager. You will work closely with marketing, sales, and strategy teams to plan and execute customer advocacy programs that showcase customer success across multiple product lines.

You will work directly with customer advocates to share their stories through industry events, media campaigns, and digital assets including case studies, videos, press releases, and blogs. You will support key strategic accounts by planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns to drive awareness, excitement, and adoption of Veeva solutions.

Identify, manage, and develop customer reference and advocacy campaigns with enterprise and emerging companies that enable Veeva marketing to lead with customer success and value
Leverage a broad and appropriate mix of marketing programs (inclusive of event marketing, direct marketing, and digital marketing) to maximize awareness, relevancy, consideration, and adoption of Veeva solutions within strategic accounts
Orchestrate and lead regular check-ins for strategic customers with sales, strategy, and customer success to ensure account goals and plans remain on track, and discuss upcoming account requirements and modifications
Produce a portfolio of assets and deliverables appropriate to marketing plan requirements
Manage program execution against committed timelines and within budget; set appropriate success KPIs and track measurements to determine impact and ROI
Ensure appropriate communication and collaboration with key stakeholders from planning through to results across all customer advocacy programs
Cultivate long-term relationships with customers and colleagues in marketing, sales, and strategy

Strong marketing experience in enterprise software
Exceptional project management skills with proven success in driving projects to completion
Experience working with customer to develop advocacy marketing materials that showcase real-world success and value across multiple channels (case studies, press releases, social media, events, etc.)
Passionate storyteller with the ability to understand industry challenges, trends, and technical concepts to turn them into compelling content
Proven ability to define, develop, and execute integrated marketing programs on time and within budget
Excellent English language/communications skills, both written and spoken
Ability to develop long-term business relationships with customers and sales teams
Strong desire to win as a team combined with the ability to work independently
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
Flexibility to travel as required

Life sciences industry relevant work experience
Demonstrable experience in managing and executing integrated marketing programs

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. With that aim in mind, we are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI’s products and platform amongst our core audiences.

We take a data-driven approach to understand our customers' needs and challenges, ensuring that their voices are reflected in product development and messaging. We then partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design teams to create a cohesive customer experience across all our channels.

Our focus extends beyond just promoting product features; we aim to provide valuable insights and resources that help our users make the most out of AI technologies.

As a Product Marketing Manager for Marketing Finance on the Hardware team, you will help shape the commercial strategy for bringing OpenAI’s hardware products to market. This role sits at the intersection of product marketing, finance, pricing, supply, distribution, and launch planning. You will help define how our products are priced, packaged, forecasted, distributed, and commercially supported across launch and lifecycle moments.
This role calls for a highly analytical and operational product marketer who can turn ambiguity into clear business recommendations. You will partner closely with Product, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Legal, Integrated Marketing, and Customer Support to ensure our go-to-market plans are commercially sound, operationally feasible, and grounded in customer and market insight.
This role reports into the Head of Product Marketing, Hardware, and offers a unique opportunity to help build the commercial foundation for a new category of AI-powered devices.

Lead pricing workstreams for OpenAI’s hardware products, partnering closely with Finance, Operations, and GTM teams.
Develop commercial models that inform launch strategy, revenue expectations, margin considerations, and long-term product lifecycle planning.
Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance on demand planning, supply constraints, inventory considerations, and launch readiness.
Help define distribution strategy across direct, retail, enterprise, partner, or other emerging channels.
Translate market, customer, competitive, and cost inputs into clear pricing and go-to-market recommendations.
Support launch planning across pricing, availability, regional rollout, sales motions, customer support, and post-purchase experience.
Build decision-making frameworks for promotions, bundles, financing, tradeoffs, and lifecycle pricing changes.
Collaborate with Integrated Marketing and Comms to ensure pricing, packaging, and availability messages are clear and customer-friendly.
Track launch and post-launch business performance, identifying opportunities to improve adoption, conversion, revenue, margin, and customer experience.
Serve as a connective tissue between marketing, finance, product, and operations to ensure commercial decisions are aligned and well-executed.

s.h: You Might Thrive In This Role If You
s.t:
Have 10+ years of experience in product marketing, marketing finance, commercial strategy, business operations, pricing strategy, or related go-to-market roles.
Have experience bringing consumer hardware, devices, subscriptions, platforms, or other complex products to market.
Are strong analytically and can build clear recommendations from imperfect data, financial models, customer insight, and business constraints.
Understand pricing, packaging, revenue modeling, margin dynamics, demand planning, and distribution tradeoffs.
Can operate across strategic and operational details, from executive-level commercial recommendations to launch execution checklists.
Are an excellent cross-functional partner who can work closely with Product, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, Sales, Support, and Marketing.
Communicate clearly and can make complex commercial decisions understandable to both business and creative audiences.
Are comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the product, category, business model, and operating model are being built in parallel.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

We're looking for a Senior Partner Field Marketing Manager to help drive Ramp's next phase of growth by building and scaling our partner field marketing strategy. You'll own the strategy behind how Ramp and our strategic partners generate pipeline together through field marketing - developing partner engagement strategies that drive net-new business through highly targeted events and account-based programs.
You'll partner closely with Alliances, Sales, Demand Generation, and Field Marketing to develop event programs that create measurable business outcomes. You'll ensure our partners are active contributors to the pipeline by driving intentional engagement, joint account strategies, and co-marketed events.
This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who thrives at the intersection of partner strategy, go-to-market execution, and revenue generation.

Own and scale Ramp's partner field marketing strategy, driving co-marketed events that generate measurable pipeline and net-new business
Develop targeted partner engagement strategies for executive dinners, roadshows, customer events, and third-party conferences, ensuring partners actively source and engage priority accounts for those direct events
Partner closely with Alliances and Sales to identify strategic partners, align on target account lists, and maximize partner contribution across every event
Own partner engagement for each initiative, holding partners accountable for bringing qualified prospects, supporting joint outreach, and generating measurable pipeline
Design partner-integrated event experiences that create meaningful engagement between partners and priority customer accounts
Develop attribution frameworks and reporting to measure partner-sourced attendance, pipeline, and program performance, using data to continuously optimize results
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Alliances, Demand Generation, and Field Marketing to align campaign strategy, account engagement, and follow-up execution
Leverage AI and automation to improve partner engagement, event campaign execution, reporting, and operational efficiency
What You Need
6+ years of experience in partner marketing, channel marketing, alliances, field marketing, or a related go-to-market function within a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company
Proven experience building partner marketing or channel marketing programs that drive measurable pipeline through strategic partner engagement
Experience building and executing top-tier executive events & conference ancillary events
Experience developing account-based partner marketing strategies in close partnership with Sales and Channel/Alliances teams
Strong understanding of partner ecosystems, joint go-to-market programs, and partner-led demand generation
Exceptional project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and external partners
Strong analytical skills with experience measuring marketing performance, attribution, and pipeline impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Actively leverages AI tools as a core part of daily work, using them to improve campaign execution, automate workflows, accelerate analysis, and increase productivity

Experience working with technology alliances, cloud partners, systems integrators, or strategic channel partners
Experience with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms (e.g., Marketo or HubSpot), and event management tools
Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) strategies and partner attribution models
Experience supporting executive events, customer advisory boards, or third-party industry conferences

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era.

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.
We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.
Docker’s Growth Marketing team turns developer momentum into enterprise pipeline, and paid media is one of the most direct levers we have. It is how we put Docker’s launches, our security and AI story, and our enterprise value in front of the right buyers at the right moment, and how we turn budget into measurable pipeline.

This role owns Docker’s paid media engine end to end across paid search, paid social, display, and programmatic, with LinkedIn and Google as the primary channels and Reddit and emerging channels in the mix.
As Digital Marketing Manager, you own the function from strategy through execution and reporting: audience and ABM targeting, channel and budget strategy, campaign build and optimization, landing-page and conversion-path quality, and the measurement that connects every dollar of spend to pipeline.

You are the strategic point of contact for our paid media agency, setting direction and holding the work to a high bar rather than handing it off. You report to the Head of Digital Marketing within Growth Marketing and partner daily with Integrated Campaigns, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Web, and Developer Relations.
What Success Looks Like
Success is measured the way the business measures it: pipeline generated and the efficiency of the spend that generated it, not lead volume or cost per lead in isolation. You own a number, not a volume of activity.

You can look at the account on any given day and know which programs are producing qualified pipeline, which are not, and what you are changing as a result. You are fluent in the full measurement chain, from platform conversion tracking through to closed-loop attribution in Salesforce, and you defend pipeline quality over vanity metrics.

You keep campaigns current with where Docker’s product and positioning actually are, so paid always reflects what we are selling now. And you bring a testing discipline that compounds: clear hypotheses, clean reads, and budget reallocated toward what works.

Own Docker’s paid media strategy and execution across paid search, paid social, display, and programmatic, with LinkedIn and Google as primary channels, tied to quarterly pipeline and efficiency targets rather than lead volume.

About Neon
Neon is a global payments and e-commerce platform designed to help game publishers earn more money and independence from app stores. We believe commerce should be open and transparent: clear decisions, actionable insights, and aligned incentives.

Founded by payments, fintech and gaming veterans, Neon focuses on product and partnership excellence: we share the playbook, co-pilot decisions, and abstract away risk and complexity for our customers. We’re replacing old-school, black-box relics with clear, modern, and developer-centric infrastructure.
As an early team member, you’ll have the opportunity to shape and scale Neon’s product and culture, making a direct impact on our growth and success. You’ll join a collaborative, diverse team from world-class companies like Apple, Affirm, Unity, and Visa, backed by renowned VC's including Thrive, a16z, Griffin Gaming, Ribbit, and Renegade. If you want to build disruptive technology, challenge the status quo, and help game creators thrive on their own terms, read on.

We are looking for a Lead Product Marketing Manager (PMM) who can own product marketing end-to-end: positioning, messaging, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market execution. As our first Product Marketing hire, you will step into a high-leverage, solo function with the mandate to build Neon’s GTM foundation from scratch.

You will serve as the foundational pillar of our marketing engine, shaping how the market perceives our core products.The core challenge is translating a genuinely complex product into messaging that lands with business-side stakeholders at game publishers & studios.
This role is right for someone who has done enterprise B2B product marketing at a fintech or SaaS company, has strong instincts for positioning in a category where most buyers do not fully understand what they are buying, and wants to build something from scratch rather than inherit a playbook.

Positioning and Messaging
Own Neon's core narrative: why MoR is the right model for publishers, how we compare to app stores and self-managed payments, and what we do differently versus competitors
Develop audience-specific messaging for publisher BD, finance, and product stakeholders.
Translate complex product capabilities (MoR, loyalty, tax) into clear, credible value propositions that do not require a payments background to understand.
Sales Enablement
Build and maintain the core sales collateral: pitch decks, one-pagers, competitive battle cards, and objection-handling guides.
Create materials for publisher onboarding that explain what Neon owns (tax, chargebacks, compliance) and what the publisher owns.
Run enablement sessions with the sales and CS team when new products or market coverage launches.
Go-to-Market Execution
Own GTM for new product launches and major market expansions. Define the audience, message, channel, and success metric.
Lead co-marketing and launch announcements with publishing partners.
Develop thought leadership content that positions Neon as the authority on direct monetization for game publishers.
Competitive and Market Intelligence
Maintain a current view of the competitive landscape: competitors, app store fee structures, and emerging direct-to-consumer tooling.
Synthesize publisher feedback and market signals into positioning updates and product roadmap input.
Track regulatory and industry trends (app store legislation, tax rule changes) that affect Neon's positioning.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Product to understand roadmap priorities and translate them into external messaging.
Work with Sales and Customer Success to build feedback loops between market signals and product direction.
Influence roadmap prioritization based on competitive gaps and publisher feedback.

7+ years in product marketing, with at least 3 years in enterprise B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments. Gaming industry experience is a strong plus.
Demonstrated ability to position a technically complex product to non-technical buyers.
Strong writing. You can write a one-pager, a LinkedIn post, and a pitch deck that all sound like they came from the same company.
Comfort with regulatory and compliance nuance. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you need to be able to explain concepts like MoR liability, chargeback ownership, and tax remittance without either oversimplifying or scaring buyers away.
Competitive analysis depth. You know how to run a rigorous teardown and turn it into actionable sales collateral.
Bias toward execution. You move quickly, produce work, and iterate rather than waiting for perfect information.
Prior experience in a founding or lead PMM role where you built the function rather than inherited it.

Experience marketing to game publishers, studios, or developer platforms.
Background in MoR, payment processing, or e-commerce infrastructure.
Experience producing high-volume content (newsletters, LinkedIn series, blog) as part of a GTM motion.
Familiarity with the competitive dynamics between app stores and direct-to-consumer monetization.

Our brands create memorable experiences through exceptional hospitality, design, food and culture. As we continue to expand across the United States and internationally, we’re looking for an ambitious digital leader to build the next chapter of our digital growth.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Digital Marketing Manager to lead the digital marketing strategy across our entire portfolio of brands.
Reporting directly to senior leadership, this role will own our digital ecosystem—from paid media and CRM to websites, SEO, analytics, reservations, online ordering and guest acquisition.
You’ll work alongside our Senior Marketing Manager, Social Media Manager, creative team, agency partners and restaurant leadership to develop digital strategies that drive measurable revenue growth while maintaining the premium positioning of each brand.
This is a highly strategic, commercially focused leadership role suited to someone who loves combining creativity, technology and data to build best-in-class hospitality brands.

Develop and execute the Group-wide digital marketing strategy across all brands.
Drive guest acquisition, retention and lifetime value.
Build annual digital marketing plans aligned with business objectives.

Develop scalable systems to support future openings and expansion.

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
At Braze, Product Marketing sits at the center of how we bring our platform to market—shaping the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that connect what we build to the value our customers feel.

As part of our Product Marketing team, you'll own narratives and GTM for the strategic technology partnerships that extend what's possible on our platform.

This is a role for a builder and a storyteller: someone energized by turning complex offerings into clear, compelling go-to-market programs, and who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with teams across Product, Sales, Partnership, and Marketing to bring them to life.

You will translate Braze's strategic technology partnerships into differentiated messaging, joint go-to-market programs, and field-ready assets that ladder up to our core platform narrative.
This is an individual contributor role focused on strong PMM craft and cross-functional execution. You'll bring a clear understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, and you'll work closely with internal cross-functional teams including Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to take initiatives from messaging through to field readiness.
GTM Strategy & Messaging
Develop GTM strategy based on joint business plans for strategic technology partnerships in collaboration with partner leads
Own the messaging architecture for Braze's strategic technology partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers and data platforms), ensuring each partnership ladders up to our core platform narrative and customer engagement story
Translate platform integrations into clear, differentiated value propositions with defined customer use cases and competitive angles
Work with Core Product Marketing to ensure technology partners are reflected accurately in product launches, campaigns, and core messaging
GTM Execution & Enablement
Drive joint go-to-market and co-marketing programs with technology platform partners, coordinating timelines and deliverables across internal teams
Drive partner launch motions end-to-end: messaging, packaging, enablement materials, and field readiness
Build and deliver core assets and enablement that actually get used in the field
Track performance and adoption, and report results back to cross-functional stakeholders
Cross-Functional Execution
Work closely with Product, GTM Strategy, Sales, Marketing, and Partnership to align on priorities and execute against them
Partner with Sales and the field to support active deals, customer conversations, and positioning
What Success Looks Like

s.h: In your first year, success means
s.t:
A repeatable launch and enablement motion for technology platform partnerships, with integrations reflected consistently across launches, campaigns, and core messaging
Trusted, productive relationships across Product, Sales, Partners, Marketing, and Services—you're the person teams pull in early

A storyteller. You turn complex offerings and integrations into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with buyers and the field alike
A builder. You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by creating structure, frameworks, and repeatable motions where none existed
A collaborator. You're a sleeves-rolled-up, low-ego operator who brings cross-functional teams along and gets things shipped without direct authority
GTM-fluent. You understand how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners and how to execute them in a fast-moving, matrixed organization

s.h: What You Bring to the Team
s.t:
7–10+ years in product and/or partner marketing at a growing B2B technology company, with strong product marketing (PMM) craft at the core
A clear, practical understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, including joint GTM programs, co-marketing motions, and integration launches
Strong PMM fundamentals: messaging frameworks, competitive positioning, narrative development, and the ability to translate complex offerings and integrations into clear, buyer-ready stories
Experience marketing technology platform partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers, data platforms, and the broader SaaS/martech ecosystem)
Experience building sales and enablement content—solution briefs, battle cards, decks, playbooks—that gets adopted and used by the field
A proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and execute without direct authority, navigating a matrixed organization to get things shipped
Excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to internal stakeholders and partners

Experience in customer engagement, marketing technology, CDP, or adjacent data/SaaS categories

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform, helping the world's most ambitious brands build absolutely engaging relationships with their customers. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to AI-powered experimentation and optimization, we put market-leading AI in the hands of marketers in one of the most dynamic categories in software. We're growing fast and expanding globally, and this role sits right at the center of how we bring that innovation to market.
Our core Product Marketing team defines how the world understands our products. This role is about what happens next: turning that messaging and positioning into a field narrative that wins. You'll be the connective tissue between Product Marketing and the GTM organization — the person who makes sure everything we bring to market is visible, understandable, and sellable across Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships.
This is a player-coach role. You'll lead a small, agile team of GTM PMMs while staying hands-on in the work yourself — and you'll have the runway to grow that team and your scope as Braze scales globally.

The field narrative: Take the core messaging and positioning built by the PMM team and shape it into a compelling, coherent story the field can carry into every conversation — by persona, segment, and stage of the funnel
The playbook, and how product information reaches the field: You own the system by which our products become legible to the GTM org: the plays, narratives, assets, and channels that ensure every seller knows what we offer, who it's for, why it matters now, and how to win against the alternatives
Technology & services delivery partner GTM: Own how we go to market with our technology and services delivery partners — enabling them on our products and narrative, partnering strategically on launches and programs, building joint go-to-market motions, and aligning priorities so that our success and our partners' success reinforce each other
Braze Services Marketing: Own the GTM narrative for our in-house services — support, onboarding, and education — and articulate the distinct value of Braze-delivered services to our customers as a meaningful differentiator
A small, agile, growing team: Lead and develop a team of GTM PMMs, setting priorities, raising the bar on craft, and building the foundation for a function that will scale globally over time
Partner with field leadership every day. Work hand-in-hand with Sales, Solutions Consultants, and CS leaders to understand where deals stall, what reps need, and how to translate product value into language that moves opportunities forward
Translate complex technology into the language of our buyers — and coach the field to do the same: You make hard things simple without making them shallow
Use AI as a force multiplier — judiciously: You're AI-literate and fluent in how AI is reshaping both martech and the practice of marketing. You know when AI meaningfully accelerates the work and when human judgment has to lead
Prioritize ruthlessly: Focus your team's energy on the narratives, launches, and plays that move the needle for the business — and have the judgment and the spine to say no to the rest
Spend time with customers: You treat customer time as a priority, not a luxury, and you bring what you learn back into the messaging, the playbook, and the roadmap conversation
How Success Is Measured
You can measure and report on your work, and you hold yourself accountable to business outcomes — not activity. Success in this role is measured against pipeline, product adoption, pipeline progression, and overall program impact, and you'll be expected to show that connection clearly and consistently.

A marketer who loves working with Sales and Customer Success. You're energized by the field, not protective of distance from it. The field trusts you as a subject-matter expert; Marketing trusts you as a strategic, thoughtful partner
A messaging craftsperson. You can take a positioning doc and a complex product and turn it into something sharp, memorable, and sales-ready. Strong messaging chops are non-negotiable
Fluent in the sales motion. You understand how deals actually get done and build for the way the field really sells
Deeply curious. You ask why. You dig into the product, the market, the competition, and the customer until you understand them well enough to make them simple
An exceptional writer and presenter. You write with clarity and edge, and you can command a room — a sales kickoff stage, an exec readout, or a field enablement session
Steeped in martech. You bring deep experience in the martech space, including a strong grasp of AI innovations and the competitive landscape
A sharp prioritizer and a builder of trust across cross-functional teams
10+ years of experience in Product Marketing, GTM/field marketing, or a closely related GTM function, including experience leading and developing people
A track record of building field-facing narratives and enablement that demonstrably influenced pipeline, deal velocity, or win rates
Deep experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in martech, with strong command of the competitive and AI landscape
Proven ability to translate complex technology into buyer-ready language — and to help a field organization do the same
Experience building joint go-to-market motions with technology or services delivery partners — enabling partners, aligning priorities, and partnering on launches and programs
Demonstrated ability to operate across functions and bring order to ambiguity
A genuine interest in marketing as a craft

Reports to: VP of Product Marketing
Location: Hybrid; must be based in one of our hub cities — New York (HQ), San Francisco, Chicago, or Austin
Travel: Up to 30%

CRM. Atira. ERP.
We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!
Why this role is a blank canvas
Brand is the one asset that compounds while everything else at a startup resets. Every deck, every customer story, every post builds on the last one, and the person who builds that foundation owns something no later hire can claim.
You will be one of the first people on our GTM team and the first owner of how Atira looks, sounds, and gets found: our positioning, our visual identity, our customer stories, and our presence in a market where no one has built a great brand yet.

You work directly with the founders, who stay hands-on with positioning while you turn it into something the whole company builds on. And you won't start from zero: you'll build on our recently completed rebranding with a top-tier design agency and turn the new identity into everything Atira ships.
You won't be someone who "supports marketing" at Atira. You'll build a company's brand from scratch in one of the hardest, most valuable B2B markets there is.

s.h: How the role sits in the team
s.t:
You are the first person at Atira whose full-time job is brand and marketing. You will define how Atira presents itself to the public, both from a strategic and operational perspective.

The role sits at the heart of our GTM team with our BDR, AE, and GTM Engineer, and you work across every department: sales needs decks and stories, engineering needs a tech blog, product needs launches told in buyer language, recruiting needs an employer brand. You are the connective tissue that makes all of it look and sound like one company.

You will shape how Atira presents itself to the public, across every medium: text, visuals, web, fairs, and events. Concretely:
Build the messaging foundation. Together with the founders, constantly refine who Atira is for, what we claim, and why we win
Own the visual identity. Consistent design across website, decks, product touchpoints, and events. You own the design system and the rules it is built upon
Make Atira visible. LinkedIn presence, customer stories, industry fairs and events. The goal is measurable: inbound interest and recognition among our target buyers and recruiting prospects
Grow into product marketing. Once the foundation stands, translate product capability into buyer language: launch narratives, one-pagers, demo storylines, side by side with our engineers and FDEs

Creativity, hunger, structure, and the kind of taste that makes Atira iconic. We care more about who you are than about your CV. We have hired strong people from non-traditional backgrounds before and will confidently do it again.

s.h: That said, here is what we typically see in strong candidates

Position Overview Own the full CRM and lifecycle marketing function for a subscription ecommerce company that is rebuilding its growth engine from the ground up.

This person will manage all email and SMS marketing through Klaviyo, build and optimize lifecycle flows that directly impact retention and revenue, run the affiliate program, and use data to continuously improve how we communicate with subscribers at every stage of their journey. You will be the only person in this seat.

There is no team to inherit — you are the team.

Core Responsibilities Own all email and SMS marketing execution in Klaviyo: campaign calendar, segmentation, A/B testing, deliverability, and performance reporting Build, maintain, and optimize lifecycle flows including dunning/failed payment recovery, pre-rebill engagement, win-back, cross-sell, gift-to-paid conversion, and new subscriber onboarding Manage audience segmentation across subscriber types (paid, gift, promo) with different communication strategies for each based on their lifecycle stage and churn profile Design and execute retention-focused campaigns that reduce voluntary churn and increase subscriber lifetime value Run the affiliate program: recruit and onboard affiliates, manage communications, track performance, and optimize incentive structures A/B test subject lines, send times, content, offers, and flow logic with statistical rigor — not just gut feel Monitor and report on email/SMS channel performance (open rates, click rates, conversion rates, revenue attribution, list health) with written analysis, not just dashboards Coordinate with the creative team on email and SMS asset needs, providing performance data to inform what gets produced next Proactively flag deliverability issues, list hygiene problems, and engagement drop-offs before they become crises Support broader growth initiatives by leveraging the email list (1.6M+ contacts) as a high-leverage owned audience channel What Makes You the Right Fit You think in systems, not sends.

Individual campaigns matter, but what you really build is the machine that nurtures subscribers from first touch through year-two renewal. You're a retention thinker. You understand that keeping a subscriber is cheaper than acquiring one, and you build flows that prove it. You're data driven but action oriented.

You don't just report that open rates dropped, you diagnose why, fix it, and document what you changed. You're proactive, not reactive. Deliverability issues, engagement cliffs, and broken flows get caught before leadership asks about them. You operate independently. This is a solo role with high ownership.

You manage your own priorities, and flag what matters. You communicate clearly. Your reports tell a story. Your briefs to creative are specific.

Vos missions
Doctolib est le leader technologique et de l’IA en santé, avec l’ambition de transformer la santé en Europe. Alors que nous enrichissons notre suite de technologies et d’assistants IA couvrant l’ensemble des activités des soignants, nous voulons renforcer la perception de Doctolib auprès des professionnels de santé et affirmer notre rôle de partenaire technologique de référence.
En tant que B2B Brand Manager, vous transformez nos enjeux business, nos propositions de valeur et les besoins des soignants en positionnements distinctifs, campagnes créatives et plans d’activation à fort impact pour le marché français. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Social Media, Content, Product Marketing, Performance, Brand Design et Communication, ainsi qu’avec nos agences créatives et média.

s.h: Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à
s.t:
Positionnement stratégique : collaborer avec les Product Marketing Managers pour construire des positionnements différenciants pour nos produits et clusters, en traduisant les enjeux business et les besoins des soignants en récits de marque clairs et convaincants.
Stratégie d’activation : concevoir des plans d’activation intégrés en définissant les formats, canaux et contenus les plus pertinents selon les audiences, les objectifs et les étapes du funnel.
Campagnes 360° : imaginer et piloter des campagnes associant communication omnicanale, activations, événements, social media et formats digitaux, de la réflexion stratégique jusqu’au déploiement média.
Messaging & copywriting : transformer nos propositions de valeur en messages simples, distinctifs et mémorables, puis les adapter avec précision aux différents canaux et formats.
Excellence créative : rédiger des briefs exigeants, accompagner et challenger les agences, designers et partenaires de production afin de garantir un niveau d'exécution élevé sur chaque prise de parole.
Pilotage de projets : orchestrer les projets de bout en bout, en assurant la coordination des équipes, la maîtrise des budgets, le respect des calendriers et la qualité des livrables.
Mesure de la performance : définir les KPIs, consolider les résultats des campagnes et transformer les enseignements en recommandations concrètes pour les prochaines activations.
Amélioration continue : partager les insights de campagne avec les autres équipes afin d’affiner nos positionnements, nos messages et nos stratégies d’activation.
Les qualités attendues pour ce poste
Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n’avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.
Vous pourrez être le/la prochain(e) membre de notre équipe si vous :
Vous parlez et écrivez couramment en français et en anglais.
Vous apportez au moins 6 ans d’expérience en Brand Management, idéalement dans une entreprise technologique, une scale-up ou un environnement B2B complexe.
Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux du brand building et savez les traduire en campagnes multicanales, activations, plans 360° et contenus sociaux.
Vous combinez une forte capacité de réflexion stratégique avec une réelle exigence dans l’exécution.
Vous avez déjà piloté des campagnes intégrées, de la définition du positionnement jusqu’à la production et au déploiement média.
Vous possédez d’excellentes compétences en storytelling, messaging et copywriting, avec la capacité de rendre simples et mémorables des parcours produit et des propositions complexes.
Vous savez sélectionner les initiatives à plus fort impact et construire un mix de canaux adapté à chaque audience et objectif.
Vous êtes à l’aise avec le pilotage d’agences, de budgets, de productions et de projets transverses.
Vous savez utiliser les données et les résultats de campagne pour guider vos décisions et améliorer vos activations.
Vous maîtrisez déjà des outils IA appliqués au marketing et vous avez une forte curiosité pour leur potentiel, afin d’accélérer la production sans compromettre la qualité.
Vous savez collaborer avec de multiples parties prenantes, défendre une vision de marque et challenger de manière constructive et humble.
Vous portez une attention sincère au quotidien des professionnels de santé, afin de créer des campagnes capables de les informer, mais aussi de les toucher.

Das ist dein Job bei uns
Mittwochmorgen. Du öffnest den Business Manager und siehst zwei neue Hooks laufen, deutlich über Benchmark.
Du erhöhst direkt die Budgets. Anschließend briefst du Anna, unsere Creative Strategistin, auf die Iteration der Best Performer.
Anna baut mit Alex, Mona und Tobi aus dem Creative Team ein neues Set. UGC, Founder Ads und mehrere Statics. Wenige Tage später gehen sie live.
Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance und die nächsten Schritte. Dazu deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Produktlaunch. Rabatte allein reichen dir nicht. Jede Bestellung muss einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag tragen.
Danach briefst du dein Team. Jeder Schritt der Kampagne ist klar verteilt. Am Launchtag knackst du für den Kunden 50.000 € Ad Spend an einem Tag, profitabel.
Genau das ist dein Job.
Wofür wir arbeiten
Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.
Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.
Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.
Wir denken Paid Social anders
Dass das Creative über die Performance entscheidet, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Das ist Standard. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel mit. Denn ein starker ROAS entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads. Er entsteht aus dem Angebot dahinter:
Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht.
Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Creative verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter.
Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer, dazu ein AI-Stack für mehr Output.
Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden.
Was dich hier erwartet
Du übernimmst nicht ein paar Werbekonten. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Wachstum deiner Kunden über Social Ads und entwickelst eigenständig die richtige Strategie.
Denn wir arbeiten nicht mit Kunden zusammen, um Kampagnen zu verwalten. Wir arbeiten mit ihnen, um sie zum Wachsen zu bringen.

Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung
Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend.
Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit Anna und dem Creative Team. UGC, Founder Ads und Statics entstehen aus Testdaten, nicht aus Bauchgefühl.
Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien. Unser Team setzt sie um und arbeitet sie im Detail aus.
Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohen Ad-Spend-Leveln nicht lange.
Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst auf Entscheiderebene, nicht nur zum Kanal
Du baust den Social Ads Bereich weiter aus, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder
Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE einmal. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für das gesamte Paid Social Team übernehmen will und sich perspektivisch als Paid Social Lead entwickelt.
Das solltest du mitbringen
Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei
Nachweisbare Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets
Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager. Dazu Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, Admetrics oder Tracify
Sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeiträgen, CAC und POAS. Ohne diese Zahlen lässt sich profitabel nicht skalieren
Strategisches Verständnis für E-Commerce. Du denkst über den Werbekanal hinaus und steuerst Projekte entlang des gesamten Kundengeschäfts
Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads. Du erkennst, warum ein Creative verkauft, und nicht nur, dass es verkauft
Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau für Kundenkommunikation und Copy-Bewertung. Englisch fließend für die Arbeit in den Ad-Managern
Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, auch weil wir 100 % remote arbeiten
Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder im Mentoring von Junioren
Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem
Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn du keine E-Commerce-Erfahrung mitbringst. Wir suchen jemanden, der Accounts auf exzellentem Niveau steuert. Fachlich challengen wir dich gern. Das E-Commerce-Know-how solltest du jedoch schon mitbringen.
Der Rahmen
100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss
30 Tage Urlaub

Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.
Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

As our Digital Marketing Specialist, you will be an experienced individual contributor responsible for driving performance across our paid digital channels, including SEM, display, and social advertising, and ensuring spend is directed where it will have the greatest impact.
This role is fully proficient within digital marketing, uses sound judgment to evaluate performance data and select the right methods for optimization, and creatively solves varied campaign challenges across audiences, channels, and account tiers. You will work independently within established practices while building effective networks with internal partners, our digital agency, and external platform contacts to improve campaign outcomes.

Agency Collaboration and Campaign Strategy
Work with our digital agency on campaign ideation, creative strategy, targeting, segmentation, and budgeting across SEM, display, and social advertising channels.
Use established campaign practices and sound judgment to reach the right accounts and buyers with the right message.
Full-Funnel Performance Measurement
Measure and report on performance across metrics that span the full buyer's funnel, from top-of-funnel awareness and engagement through pipeline and revenue impact.
Evaluate identifiable factors and translate results into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Campaign Integration
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product marketing, field marketing, and demand generation, to support their initiatives.
Bring integrated, cohesive campaigns to life across paid digital channels.
Account Tiering and ABM-Aligned Spend
Apply an account tiering and ABM approach to digital spend.
Adjust budget, targeting, and prioritization based on account tier so that investment scales with account value and strategic importance.
Experimentation and Optimization
Develop and run structured tests across digital campaigns, including creative, targeting, channels, and bidding strategies.
Resolve performance issues in creative ways, improve outcomes, and inform practical recommendations for broader digital strategy.
Market and Channel Trends
Stay on top of current market trends.
Identify new and emerging channels, tools, and tactics.
Bring forward recommendations to keep 6sense's digital program ahead of the curve.
Budget and Resource Management
Manage budgets across SEM, display, and social channels effectively.
Ensure spend is allocated to maximize ROI and pipeline contribution.
Performance Measurement
Full-Funnel Digital Performance
Performance across the full buyer's funnel, from impressions and engagement to pipeline and revenue.
Clear attribution back to channel and campaign.
Account Tier Efficiency
Efficiency of spend allocation across account tiers.
Measured by engagement and pipeline generated relative to investment at each tier.
Experimentation Velocity and Impact
Number and quality of tests run through the experimentation framework.
Resulting lift in campaign performance.
Agency and Cross-Functional Execution Quality
On-time, on-strategy delivery of campaigns developed with the digital agency and cross-functional partners.
Measurable performance improvement as a result.
Competencies and Behaviors
Digital Channel Proficiency
Fully proficient in SEM, display, and social advertising platforms.
Demonstrates sound judgment in selecting appropriate methods, techniques, and tactics for a given audience, account tier, and campaign objective.
Revenue-First Thinking
Connects every campaign to pipeline and revenue.
Does not measure success by impressions or clicks alone.
Asks "What did this produce?" and builds campaigns designed to answer that question.
Analytical Judgment
Comfortable evaluating diverse performance data.
Identifies the factors that matter most.
Forms hypotheses and designs tests that produce clear, decision-ready answers.
Internal and External Networking
Builds productive relationships with senior internal partners, the digital agency, and external platform contacts.
Removes blockers, improves execution, and strengthens campaign outcomes.
Curiosity and Adaptability
Actively tracks emerging channels and market shifts.
Quickly tests and adopts approaches that improve performance.

Typically 5+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor's degree, or 3+ years with a master's degree.
Hands-on experience managing SEM, display, and social advertising campaigns, ideally in partnership with an external agency.
Experience measuring and reporting on full-funnel performance, connecting top-of-funnel digital activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Experience applying an account tiering or ABM approach to digital spend, adjusting targeting and budget based on account prioritization.
A track record of building and running experimentation frameworks to drive continuous improvement in paid digital performance.
Familiarity with the B2B SaaS marketing technology ecosystem, including ad platforms, analytics tools, and ABM/intent data providers.
Full understanding of digital marketing within a B2B SaaS environment, with the ability to resolve campaign performance issues in creative, practical ways.

Additionally, you will play a vital role in customer advocacy, lead nurturing, contractor/builder collateral strategy and supporting training and engagement events. The successful candidate will work closely with the field sales team and strategic account managers to implement effective pull strategies.

Loyalty Program Management
Own the day-to-day management of the Contractor Loyalty Program—ensuring program rules, product eligibility, contractor data accuracy, and compliance are maintained.
Develop and deploy enrollment strategies to increase program membership
Manage contractor onboarding, enrollment, and field enablement related to the program, in partnership with Field Sales teams.
Build out customer benefit sets that drive program advantage amongst competitor programs
Collaborate with Marketing and Sales on contractor promotions and incentives that drive product adoption and share of wallet.
Equip field teams with program training, onboarding guides, and promotional tools to drive contractor awareness and participation.
Support the launch and adoption of field initiatives tied to the loyalty platform, including contractor education events and targeted campaigns.
Contractor Growth Strategy Execution
Build out the nurture strategy for driving trial and conversion of contractor prospects
Develop selling tools and conversion incentives for sales team execution
Design and execute the event strategy for contractor events, including national and regional trade shows, distributor events
Serve as the dedicated marketing point of contact for large strategic contractor accounts
Stay up to date with industry trends and competitive landscape to identify new opportunities for customer engagement and marketing initiatives
Deliver monthly reporting on all programs
Contractor Data Management and Insights

Leverage program analytics to disseminate data insights into the business. Support Field teams with localized contractor data and territory action plans.
Partner with IT, Vendors, and Data teams to optimize contractor data & insights
Builder Program Management
Develop pitch decks in collaboration with the sales team for national and regional builder opportunities, annual meetings
Develop selling tools (brochures, sell sheets, image libraries, etc.) to support the builder channel in new opportunity acquisition
Support homeowner facing design centers and cobranded homeowner campaigns for large strategic builder accounts

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
2 years+ Experience managing loyalty or credentialing programs
5+ years experience in marketing roles focused on pull strategies and engagement initiatives with trades audiences
Understanding of the new construction, repair and remodel industries, and contractor and builder segments preferred
Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing campaigns and initiatives, including managing key account relationships
Proficiency in marketing tools and software applications
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders

We have been made aware of multiple scams whereby unauthorized individuals are using Cornerstone Building Brand's name and logo to solicit potential job-seekers for employment. In some cases, job-seekers are being contacted directly, both by phone and e-mail.

In other instances, these unauthorized individuals are placing advertisements for fake positions with both legitimate websites and fabricated ones. Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager – Foundation Pillar
Team: Product Marketing
Reports to: VP, Product Marketing

6sense is the GTM Intelligence Platform, and Foundation is the layer the rest of it stands on — "platform, data, infrastructure: the backbone everything builds on." It owns account and people data, matching and identity, the APIs and MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and the workflows that move data through the system. When buyers ask whether 6sense is accurate, extensible, secure, and composable, the answer lives here.
We're looking for a Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager to own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for the Foundation pillar. This is the most technical seat on the PMM team.

You'll translate deep capabilities — identity resolution, data coverage and accuracy, API extensibility, the MCP framework, security and compliance — into differentiated stories that win over the technical and economic buyers who scrutinize them: RevOps architects, IT and security teams, data leaders, and increasingly developers building agentic GTM stacks.
You'll also carry one of the most strategically important narratives in the company: that 6sense is a composable intelligence layer other systems and AI agents plug into — "AI to the data, not data to the AI" — rather than a closed destination. With the MCP framework moving to GA, this is a present-tense story, and you'll be the one who tells it credibly.
What You'll Own
Positioning and messaging for the Foundation pillar — platform, data, infrastructure, identity and matching, APIs and the MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and workflows. You set the narrative and keep it coherent with the Intelligence and Activation pillars.
Technical proof. Turn capability into credibility: architecture explainers, technical briefs and whitepapers, benchmarks, and reference narratives that substantiate the "backbone everything builds on" claim — especially around data accuracy, coverage, and identity resolution.
The composable / MCP-agent story. Own the infrastructure-layer narrative — 6sense as the data and intelligence layer that agentic GTM stacks compose with. Lead GTM for the MCP framework and the developer / technical-buyer audience it opens up.
Differentiation for the data and identity layer. Make the case against point data providers and infrastructure alternatives — coverage, match rates, identity quality, enrichment, security posture — and arm the field to win on it.
Field and partner enablement for technical evaluations. Build the battlecards, objection handling, FAQs, and solution content that win RFPs, security reviews, and technical POCs. Partner with Sales Engineering to make the technical buyer's diligence a place 6sense wins.
Launches. Drive end-to-end GTM for Foundation releases: new data assets, API and MCP capabilities, security packages (SCIM, SSO role mapping, audit, custom roles), connectors, and workflow features.
Cross-functional partnership. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Foundation Product and Engineering leaders to shape roadmap-to-market, and with Customer Success to surface the post-sale and admin/security use cases that prove the platform's breadth.
Market and competitive intelligence for the data and platform layer, feeding insight back into roadmap and pricing/packaging conversations.

8+ years in product marketing, technical product management, or a closely related function, with substantial technical PMM experience for platform, data, infrastructure, API, or developer products.
A proven ability to translate technical concepts — APIs, data pipelines, identity resolution, integrations, security, and AI/agent architectures like MCP — into crisp positioning and business value, without losing the engineers in the room or the buyers outside it.
A track record owning messaging for technical products and enabling technical sales motions (Sales Engineering, RFPs, security reviews, POCs).
Hands-on, not hand-wavy. You'll personally call the APIs, stand up and configure the MCP server, connect it to an agent, and build the demo — and your messaging is sharper because you've done the thing, not just read the spec.
Strong writing — you can produce content that is technically rigorous and genuinely clear, from a one-line value prop to an architecture whitepaper.
Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, or data platforms, and comfort selling to technical and economic buyers (RevOps architects, IT, security, data teams, developers).
The judgment and presence to operate as a senior individual contributor: set strategy, lead cross-functionally without authority, and influence product and executive stakeholders.

Hands-on familiarity with data enrichment and identity (waterfall enrichment, matching, intent data), MCP and agentic AI architectures, or composable/API-first platforms.
Experience marketing to developers or technical evaluators, including documentation-adjacent and developer-community work.
Background in or adjacent to GTM intelligence, ABM, sales intelligence, CDP, iPaaS, or identity platforms.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 6–12 months, Foundation has a differentiated, defensible position that technical buyers recognize; the composable/MCP infrastructure story is landed with the field and the market as something that exists today, not a roadmap promise; the data and identity credibility story is substantiated with proof, not assertion; and the field has the enablement to win the technical evaluation every time it comes.
