s.t:
OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.
The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth.

We are seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to build, own, and lead lifecycle programs for SMB advertisers at OpenAI. This is a zero-to-one opportunity to establish the strategy and programs that guide businesses from initial interest and their first campaign to sustained success and growth.
You will set the lifecycle strategy, own the program roadmap and performance goals, and lead delivery from customer insight and journey design through launch, measurement, and iteration. Combining behavioral insights, experimentation, and personalized engagement across email, product experiences, education, and other channels, you will build programs that scale with the business. Success requires independent judgment, analytical depth, cross-functional leadership, and hands-on execution.
In This Role, You Will
Own the lifecycle program portfolio across prospect conversion, activation, retention, repeat spend, reactivation, and expansion.
Map advertiser journeys using cohort analysis, product behavior, campaign performance, and customer feedback to identify high-impact growth opportunities.
Build segmented, triggered journeys that connect advertiser needs, intent, readiness, and behavior to relevant messages and next steps.
Lead prospect nurture and email acquisition programs. Coordinate audiences, retargeting, and conversion experiences with Growth Marketing.
Launch onboarding and education programs that help advertisers create campaigns, understand performance, adopt capabilities, and grow their investment.
Coordinate delivery across email, in-product and onsite experiences, retargeting, education, and sales engagement with channel and product teams.
Test audiences, messaging, channels, timing, frequency, and offers. Use holdouts and downstream results to measure incremental customer impact.
Define data signals, segmentation, instrumentation, automation, and measurement with Data Science, Marketing Operations, prospect intelligence teams, and Ads Engineering.
Maintain high standards for journey quality, contact frequency, suppression, consent, and deliverability with operations and privacy partners.
Improve activation, time to first campaign, retention, repeat spend, reactivation, and expansion. Scale effective programs and use AI to accelerate content, personalization, and analysis.
You Might Thrive in This Role If You
Demonstrate a track record of building and leading lifecycle programs from strategy through execution, with measurable activation, retention, or customer-growth results.
Translate customer behavior into effective engagement strategies through customer empathy, clear communication, and disciplined prioritization.
Build behavioral segmentation and triggered programs using product and customer signals across multiple channels.
Apply cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, retention measurement, and experimental design to distinguish engagement from incremental customer outcomes.
Bring hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, such as Marketo or comparable tools, including journey logic, personalization, and quality assurance.
Lead cross-functional programs with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Marketing Operations, aligning priorities and driving delivery.
Set strategy and launch programs in fast-moving environments while establishing repeatable processes and reliable measurement.
Bring experience with SMBs, self-serve products, advertising, SaaS, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-volume customer journeys. Use AI thoughtfully to improve personalization and execution.

Experience building lifecycle programs for SMB advertisers or self-serve advertising platforms.
Track record launching onboarding and education programs that accelerate first campaign creation and repeat spend.
Experience connecting email, in-product messaging, retargeting, and sales engagement into coordinated customer journeys.
Experience using holdout tests and cohort analysis to measure incremental retention and revenue impact.
Hands-on experience establishing behavioral triggers, automation, and measurement for new lifecycle programs.
Experience applying AI to improve personalization, content development, and campaign analysis.
Workplace & Location
San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday.

Level: I3
Location: Dubai, UAE
Hiring Manager: Syed Umair Ali
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do.
We're looking for a Marketing Executive, Value & Promotions to join our Marketing Team in Dubai. This is a hybrid role.

As Marketing Executive, Value & Promotions, you will report to the Senior Marketing Manager, Value & Promotions for the Middle East. You will own the day-to-day delivery and performance of our promotional and incentive campaigns, working cross-functionally to ensure every offer is targeted, well-timed, and commercially sound.
Incentives sit at the centre of how customers experience value on the platform - they influence whether someone tries the app, comes back, or drifts away. This role owns that layer day to day: turning the promotional calendar into targeted campaigns across the customer lifecycle, and making sure every campaign earns its budget.

You’ll be joining the Middle East Marketing team. You will work cross-functionally with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Tech, Data Science, and Global/Central teams to build promotional plans that improve customer experience and drive operational excellence.

s.h: Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like
s.t:
Promotional Calendar Execution: Own the day-to-day execution of the Middle East promotional calendar, translating the quarterly plan into targeted campaigns across the customer lifecycle: acquisition, activation, retention, and win-back.
Promo Strategy Development: Contribute to the development of strategies focused on how value propositions can change customer behavior and drive ROI for Deliveroo and our Partners.
CRM & Lifecycle Campaigns: Work with CRM and Tech to build and deploy in-app and lifecycle campaigns, ensuring offers reach the right customer segment at the right moment.
Campaign Set-up & Accuracy: Own the set-up of promotions end to end - eligibility, caps, dates, and copy - so every offer goes live as briefed and on time.
Customer-centric Programmes: Work with Data Science to translate customer and performance data into promo mechanics that are genuinely relevant, not just discounted.
Budget Tracking: Own campaign-level budget tracking and reporting, flagging when a promotion’s ROI or margin impact is off plan.
Performance Optimization: Own weekly reporting on in-flight campaign performance and post-campaign analysis, identifying what worked, what didn’t, and what’s worth testing next.
Test & Learn Agenda: Design and run local test-and-learn experiments, feeding results back into the broader promotional strategy.
Competition Monitoring: Keep on top of competitor trends and market activity to keep our offers sharp and well-positioned.
Customer Advocacy: Champion the consumer voice, ensuring every promotion offers genuine value rather than just a lower price.

Experience: 2-4 years of experience in Growth Marketing, CRM, Campaign Management, Marketing, Commercial Strategy, or Promotions within a high-growth technology, marketplace, e-commerce, or consumer platform.
Commercial Acumen: Experience owning or supporting customer incentive strategies and promotional campaigns that drive measurable business outcomes, with working knowledge of core commercial metrics (CAC, LTV, GMV, margin impact) and how promotional decisions move them.
Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Analytics, or a related discipline.
Analytical Rigor: Strong analytical skills - proficient in Excel, Google Sheets, and BI tools like Looker, and comfortable interpreting data to shape campaign decisions.
Technical know-how: Experience running or supporting A/B tests and translating results into recommendations.
Attention to Detail: Organised and accurate, able to run several campaigns at once without letting the details slip.
Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple cross-functional stakeholders and the confidence to communicate at all levels.
Execution Focus: A self-starter attitude, with a proven ability to deliver results quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced, matrixed organisation.
Language Skills: Fluent English; Arabic language skills are an advantage in this market.

About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Product Marketing at Faire is a strategic function embedded across the product lifecycle. PMMs partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Revenue to shape programs from the ground up, develop positioning and messaging, lead GTM strategy, and drive awareness and adoption. We have PMMs focused on each side of the marketplace: the brands who sell on Faire, and the retailers who buy from them.
We're looking for a senior product marketer who can own a meaningful product area, build GTM strategy from scratch, and grow their remit over time as business needs shift. This is a role for someone who makes complex products feel simple to customers, moves comfortably between strategy and execution, and brings clarity to ambiguous problems across a cross-functional team.
Positioning and messaging
Develop deep customer understanding for your product area and translate those insights into clear, compelling positioning.
Make Faire feel simple to customers. Cut jargon, kill messaging that doesn't matter, and push back on product complexity that won't land.
Sharpen the positioning of products that already have a story, repositioning them so they land with a new or shifting audience.
Hold the thread across multiple launches in your area, surfacing a coherent narrative rather than a stack of individual product stories.
GTM strategy and execution
Build and own end-to-end GTM strategy for your product area, from positioning through launch and adoption.
Ship directionally right launches fast. Comfortable making calls with 70% of the information and adjusting after, rather than waiting for perfect.
Execute across multiple channels, sequencing customer education to drive behavior change at the right moments in the journey.
Coordinate cross-functional enablement across Revenue, CX, Lifecycle, and other partners to bring GTM plans to life.
Act as a customer-centric thought partner to Product, Design, Legal, and other stakeholders as your products evolve. Get involved upstream and shape roadmaps through customer insight.
Team and craft
Spend real time with customers and bring their POV into strategic conversations. Ground decisions in research and feedback rather than internal assumptions.
Use AI tools to sharpen and accelerate your work, and contribute to a culture of peer learning on the PMM team around how we experiment with and adopt AI.

Required
6+ years of product marketing experience, or an adjacent role with direct ownership of positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and GTM strategy for complex products.
Track record of building positioning from scratch and reworking the positioning of existing products, then driving consistency across multiple channels.
Builder who makes order from chaos. Comfortable when the path isn't obvious, and energized by the chance to create structure where there is none.
Experience building thematic campaigns across product areas, not just siloed launches.
Uses data to size opportunities, measure impact, and pressure-test strategy. Fluent in the metrics that move the business.
Experience conducting or directing customer research and translating findings into positioning.
Actively experiments with and adopts AI tools to sharpen and accelerate their work, and helps the team find real ways to use AI in PMM craft.

Familiarity with how independent retailers or small business owners make decisions and what earns their trust.
Two-sided marketplace background, where brand and buyer motions are distinct but interdependent
Background in STEM, management consulting, finance, or other quantitative fields.
Experience in high-growth or scaling environments where PMM infrastructure was still being built.

We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community.

We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Why this role is on the menu
Instacart+ is Instacart's membership program, the connective tissue between the brand and its most loyal, high-value customers. With benefits like $0 delivery fees, partner perks, and exclusive savings, Instacart+ is the foundation of our long-term customer relationship strategy. Members shop more, spend more, and stay longer, and this role is responsible for making sure more customers become Instacart+ members and realize the benefits of doing so.
We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the full go-to-market strategy for Instacart+. You'll shape how we position, message, and grow the membership program from acquisition campaigns that convert first-timers to lifecycle strategies that deepen engagement with existing members. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the intersection of product, brand, and growth.
The ideal candidate has deep roots in subscription or loyalty marketing, having grown a membership program, driven retention through value communication, and knows how to make the math of membership feel like a no-brainer to a consumer. You bring both the analytical rigor to understand what's working and the storytelling instinct to make it resonate. This role reports to the Director, Consumer Product Marketing.
What you'll cook up in your first year
Own the Instacart+ differentiated positioning that sets it apart from competing membership and subscription offerings.
Members have a reason to stay: you've identified the moments where member value is highest and built messaging and lifecycle programs that bring those moments to life across email, push, in-app, and paid.
Acquisition is measurably stronger: you've partnered with growth and performance marketing teams to develop and test messaging frameworks that convert trial users and lapsed members into committed subscribers.
The product roadmap reflects member insights: you've become the internal voice of the Instacart+ member, bringing qualitative and quantitative research into roadmap conversations that shape what gets built next.
New Instacart+ features launch with best-in-class GTM plans: you own the brief, the messaging, and the channel strategy from kickoff through post-launch performance review.
Senior stakeholders and XFN partners trust you as the category expert: you've developed a compelling POV on the subscription and loyalty landscape and use it to sharpen the Instacart+ strategy.

About Hatch
Hatch is an AI agent lead management platform that helps services businesses turn every customer interaction into revenue growth. Our AI agents handle conversations over SMS, email, and voice—24/7—enabling businesses to scale 1:1 communication without scaling headcount.
Recently acquired by Yelp, Hatch operates as a standalone product and is expanding our reach to help thousands more businesses unlock the revenue sitting in their lead pipeline. We've driven $5.1B in revenue for our customers—and we're just getting started.

We're hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager to run our partner program — one of Hatch's highest-leverage growth channels. Rather than a channel support role, this is a co-marketing, co-sell, and relationship-driven one — and you'll own it end to end.
You'll be the main point of contact and connective tissue between Hatch and our partners the person they come to for events, campaigns, and co-created content — and you'll pull in the right people across marketing (product marketing, enablement, content, field marketing) to make it happen.
This is high-impact work. Strong partnerships drive pipeline, expand our reach, and build Hatch's credibility across the industry — and you'll be in charge of scaling that program.

Help land new partners : partner with product marketing and enablement to produce the collateral BD uses to pitch and land new partners.
New strategic partner and integration launches : Onboard and announce new partners and product integrations across email, blog, website, and social — working with product marketing on the integration's value prop.
Co-marketing campaigns : Plan and execute co-branded campaigns — launches, webinars, ebooks, seasonal offers — tapping partners as a distribution channel to get Hatch's content in front of their audiences. You'll own the partner relationship and the plan, and partner with content and product marketing on assets, talk tracks, and speakers.
Partner program management : For partners with year-round programs (newsletter placements, blog posts, committed content), own the fulfillment — producing some content yourself and pulling in content, PMM, and enablement for the rest. You'll also help keep Hatch's listings and profiles on partner sites accurate and up to date.
Partner enablement : Scope the collateral partners need to speak fluently about Hatch to their audiences, and partner with product marketing and enablement to produce it. As Hatch evolves, keep partners in the loop and their materials current — so their knowledge of Hatch stays fresh.
Partner events : Work with field marketing on partner events and VIP experiences, contributing partner context, messaging, and coordination.
Repeatable playbooks & scaling : Turn one-off partner activations into repeatable playbooks, so the program scales efficiently as we add partners and move into new verticals.
Partner relationships : Maintain ongoing relationships with partner contacts — regular syncs, staying current on their updates, and keeping communication flowing — and proactively bring partners ideas for campaigns and content.
Tracking & optimization : Measure and optimize partner ROI, track referral handoffs, and improve lead quality from partner activity.

Relevant background: 4–7 years in partner marketing, co-marketing, or related B2B SaaS marketing (product or content)
Natural relationship-builder: comfortable being the face of Hatch to partners, building trust, and managing external stakeholders
Strong project management: you can juggle multiple partners and orchestrate deliverables across internal teams you don't manage — knowing when to set direction and when to step back — and keep a dozen moving parts on track and shipping on time
Solid content and campaign instincts: you can develop narratives, campaign angles, and webinar topics, and produce or shape content across formats
Multi-partner-type experience: you've worked across associations, tech platforms, and agencies — not just one vertical
Fluent in pipeline language: SQOs, referral attribution, and co-marketing ROI
Thrives in a build-stage environment: comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace, and energized by shaping a program rather than inheriting a finished one
